_comment: Expected behaviour per sample question, written from the corpus text itself (no outside knowledge). must_include strings must appear in the claim texts; must_cite documents must appear in claim citations; must_not_include strings must NOT appear in claim texts (superseded-edition sections are excluded from that check). Verdicts: correct / abstained / wrong. held_out_score mirrors the brief: correct +1, abstain 0, wrong -1.

questions.question: What is the first-line antibiotic, dose basis, and duration for acute otitis media in a child?

A 6-year-old with non-severe community pneumonia: what is the amoxicillin dose exactly as the workflow states it? (Dose question — retrieve and cite the text as written; do not compute for any specific child.)
must_include: Amoxicillin 40 mg/kg/day in three divided doses for 5 days

questions.question: What is the first-line initial drug therapy for newly diagnosed adult hypertension? (Note: the pack may contain more than one edition of this workflow.)
must_include: Amlodipine 5 mg once daily OR Telmisartan 40 mg once daily

questions.question: Which analgesic class must be avoided in suspected dengue, and why?
What are the ORS volumes after each loose stool for a child aged 2–10 years, and what zinc course accompanies it?
must_include: Zinc 20 mg once daily for 14 days

questions.question: Which red flags in acute low back pain mandate imaging or referral?
Which urinary antibiotic is avoided at 36+ weeks of pregnancy, and what is the stated alternative?
must_include: Cefixime 200 mg twice daily for 5 days

questions.question: At what HbA1c threshold at diagnosis does the workflow add a second agent to metformin, and which agent?
must_include: HbA1c ≥8.5% at diagnosis: add Glimepiride 1 mg

questions.question: What is the first-line prophylactic drug for migraine in adults?
What is the standard drug regimen for newly diagnosed pulmonary tuberculosis?
Per the clinic's own protocol, when are empirical antibiotics started in adult acute undifferentiated fever — and does the national workflow pack say the same? Label your sources.
must_include: Azithromycin 500 mg once daily for 3 days
